resources.string: The primary Key is tried first. On HTTP 401, 402, 403 or 429, secondary Keys are tried in order. Keys are included only in backups with secrets enabled.

Sign in with an account from a New API site that allows password sign-in. Lyra Code syncs account details, API keys and available models. The site handles sign-in and model requests under its own terms and privacy policy. For sign-in methods required by your site, open the site directly.
Create an account in this app
Enter the code from your authenticator app or a backup code.
Registration succeeded. Sign in with your new account.
Platform information, API Keys and models have been synced.
Signed in. Service synchronization is incomplete; use Sync Keys and models to retry.
Signing out turns off auto sign-in and clears the local session. Remembered credentials remain available for the next manual sign-in; configured model services and Keys remain until you remove them.
The platform request failed. Try again.

New API sign-in is optional. Lyra Code contacts the New API site you enter when you register, sign in, sign out, refresh, sync, or when enabled auto sign-in checks or restores your session. Each action sends the account information it requires, which may include your username, password, email, verification code, optional invitation code, access token or session cookie. Credentials are saved encrypted on this device only if you enable Remember credentials. Auto sign-in checks the session when the app starts and signs in again with saved credentials when the session expires. Two-factor verification requires manual input. User information, session cookies and API keys are stored locally. Account sessions and remembered credentials are excluded from app backups and Android backup and transfer. Primary and secondary model keys are exported only when you include secrets in a backup. When you use the model service, Lyra Code sends model requests directly to the site under its terms and privacy policy. Signing out disables auto sign-in, keeps remembered credentials for the next manual sign-in, clears the local session and attempts to revoke it on the site. Synced model services and keys can be removed in Model services.
Hold to show this API Key; release to hide

Remembered credentials are encrypted on this device and filled in next time. Auto sign-in requires remembered credentials. Signing out turns off auto sign-in; two-factor verification still requires your input.
Encrypted storage is unavailable on this device. You can sign in, but credentials cannot be remembered.
Enter a site URL beginning with https:// or http://.
